proposition: What naw-mulhidan meant as applied to Ibn Turka (freethinking subversion, neo-batini belief, or Ismaʿili leanings) cannot be determined from the material Melvin-Koushki gives; he thinks an Ismaʿili charge is possible.

mediation.note: MK's own interpretation, offered in support of his thesis that Ibn Turka was an occult philosopher.
